name: Assetz Muse & Maison
description: A single-tower project of 128 3 BHK homes on about 2 acres at Gattahalli, off Hosa Road, with 78% of the site left open. The design uses terracotta jaalis, and homes have terrace balconies of up to 12' x 8'.
curation: A small community of 128 homes in one tower
Terrace balconies of up to 12' x 8'
About 5 mins from Hosa Road Metro and 15 mins from Electronic City
developerNote: Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Bengaluru, Assetz Property Group lists 50+ projects and over 50 million sq.ft of development in its portfolio.
photoDescription: Single residential tower above a tree-lined street
